thesis: A sufficient representation preserves every distinction needed by a declared test family, with information and computation considered separately.
role: Establish the loss bound and learning as refinement.

ideas.statement: A sufficient representation preserves every distinction needed by a declared test family, with information and computation considered separately.
ideas.recurrenceCandidate: Establish the loss bound and learning as refinement.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Opposite orderings compressed to the same event set cannot exceed 50% expected accuracy when equiprobable and no side channel exists.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The source archive may enable a new distinction, but discarded information cannot be restored by computation and current sufficiency is not universal.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
